note: Pillar 1 of benchmark-verify. Every functional requirement enumerated from the input design docs (L1-L9) + the generated L1-L13 + declaration.json, each bound to a concrete verification item run against the GENERATED RTL (phase2/stage1/rtl/spm.v) and confirmed PASS. No requirement waived. Evidence files are relative to benchmark_clean/spm/.

verification_items.VEC10013: phase2/stage1/sim/tb_spm.v over phase2/stage1/sim/vectors.hex — 10,013 vectors at N=32, golden = (x*y) mod 2^32 reassembled LSB-first; RESULT: PASS (0 mismatches). Log: cross_check/p12/step_04.md.
verification_items.DIRECTED: verify/tb_func.v run at N=8/16/32 (45 directed/corner/reset/encoding checks). Log: verify/func_directed.log; all three RESULT: PASS.
verification_items.COSIM: phase2/stage1/sim/tb_cosim.v — OUR RTL vs upstream reference RTL over 10,013 vectors; RESULT: EQUIVALENT (0 per-cycle mismatches). Cross-check: cross_check/p12/step_01.md.
verification_items.FORMAL: SymbiYosys k-induction (unbounded) equivalence of OUR spm size=8 serial stream to (x*y) mod 2^8 — successful proof. Cross-check: cross_check/p12/step_05.md.
verification_items.STA: Multi-corner post-route STA MET at SS/TT/FF @10ns (latency/sync-clock contract honored physically). Cross-check: cross_check/p3/step_22.md; RESULT.md.

requirements.desc: p == (x*y) mod 2^N for the declared bit patterns (signed_2c / unsigned)
requirements.verify: VEC10013 + DIRECTED + FORMAL

requirements.desc: signed_2c and unsigned operands yield identical N-bit product bit-pattern (modulo-2^N property)
requirements.verify: DIRECTED (enc-id check, N=8/16/32)

requirements.desc: Port set is exactly clk, rst, x[size-1:0], y, p with declared directions
requirements.verify: RTL elaboration of spm.v + all TBs instantiate this exact port set

requirements.desc: x is the parallel multiplicand (N bits presented at once, held stable during a multiply)
requirements.verify: VEC10013 + DIRECTED (x driven once per multiply, held stable; products correct)

requirements.desc: y is consumed serially, exactly 1 bit per clock cycle
requirements.verify: DIRECTED + VEC10013 (one y bit driven per negedge; N cycles per multiply)

requirements.desc: p is emitted serially, exactly 1 bit per clock cycle
requirements.verify: DIRECTED + VEC10013 (one p bit sampled per cycle; full word reassembles correctly)

requirements.desc: Serial-y intake honors the declared LSB-first order
requirements.verify: VEC10013 + DIRECTED (yi[k] driven k=0..N-1 LSB-first; matches golden)

requirements.desc: Serial-p output honors the declared LSB-first order
requirements.verify: VEC10013 + DIRECTED (p sampled into got[k] LSB-first; matches golden)

requirements.desc: All data sampled and emitted on clk rising edge (fully synchronous)
requirements.verify: RTL (single always @(posedge clk)) + STA sign-off (single-clock domain)

requirements.desc: Declared latency honored: product bit i observed on p at cycle i+1
requirements.verify: VEC10013 + DIRECTED (negedge-drive/negedge-sample alignment proves lat=1; products correct)

requirements.desc: Synchronous active-high reset: while rst=1, internal state and p are cleared/held 0
requirements.verify: DIRECTED (rst-during: p held 0 under sustained rst, N=32)

requirements.source: L3 (one cycle to zero) / L2 (reset must enable correct start)
requirements.desc: After rst deasserts, the array is initialized so the next multiply computes correctly
requirements.verify: VEC10013 + DIRECTED (every multiply prefixed by 1-cycle rst; all correct)

requirements.desc: Reset asserted in the middle of a computation recovers cleanly on the next multiply
requirements.verify: DIRECTED (mid-rst, N=8/16/32) + tb_spm mid-computation reset recovery PASS

requirements.desc: Corner operands x/y in {0, MAX_POS, MIN_NEG, -1, 1} all produce correct product
requirements.verify: DIRECTED (x=0,y=0; x=-1; MAXP; MINN; identity; -1*-1 etc — all PASS, N=8/16/32)

requirements.desc: Back-to-back continuous multiplications keep internal state correct between operations
requirements.verify: DIRECTED (b2b-1/b2b-2 immediately consecutive; both correct) + 10,013 vectors run consecutively

requirements.desc: N=32 primary width: functional + full sign-off correctness
requirements.verify: VEC10013 + DIRECTED(N=32) + COSIM(N=32) + multi-corner STA MET

requirements.source: L3 param range / L7.1.4 secondary widths
requirements.desc: N=8 secondary width functionally correct
requirements.verify: DIRECTED(N=8) all PASS + FORMAL k-induction proof at size=8

requirements.source: L3 param range / L7.1.4 secondary widths
requirements.desc: N=16 secondary width functionally correct
requirements.verify: DIRECTED(N=16) all PASS

requirements.desc: OUR RTL is functionally equivalent to the upstream reference RTL (same p stream for same stimulus)
requirements.verify: COSIM EQUIVALENT (10,013 vectors, 0 per-cycle mismatch)

requirements.desc: Formal (unbounded) proof of equivalence to the modulo product
requirements.verify: FORMAL SymbiYosys k-induction successful (size=8, width-parametric recurrence)

requirements.desc: Module is width-parameterized via `size` and elaborates for 8/16/32
requirements.verify: All TBs instantiate spm #(.size(N)) for N in {8,16,32}; elaborate + run clean
